CSV module

CSV utilities for the School Management System

This module provides import/export helpers for Students, Instructors, and Courses.

Author: Hilda Awada

CSV.export_all(folder: str)[source]

Export all data to CSV files.

Parameters:

folder (str) – Target directory

CSV.import_all(folder: str)[source]

Import all data from CSV files and reset DB.

Parameters:

folder (str) – Directory containing students.csv, instructors.csv, courses.csv
